summary: Skier caught and injured in an avalanche ~11,500 ft in the Currant Creek area of Berthoud Pass; slide ~100 ft wide, 40 ft long in wet heavy spring snow on a weak base with strong winds; knee injury; skiing with two companions, one called 911; 13 Grand County SAR rescuers responded and carried the injured skier out on a litter; the other two skied out on their own
notes: Verified against the full backcountrymagazine.com BC Banter article at run 165 (2026-09-12): article says On Sunday, May 10 [2015], skier caught in an avalanche on Berthoud Pass at ~11,500 ft in the Currant Creek area; slide 100 ft wide x 40 ft long; skiing with another man and woman; knee injury; one called 911; thirteen Grand County rescuers responded and carried the injured skier out on a litter; the remaining skiers skied out on their own. Date pinned: 2015-05-10 was a Sunday. Article images dated 2015/05.
